name: Happy Path — Personal Current Account Opening
description: Full happy path sequence for JRN-001. A UK resident aged 18+ applies via mobile app, passes digital identity verification first attempt, receives a CLEAR PEP/sanctions/adverse media result with a Low (simplified) risk score, is automatically approved, has their account provisioned with sort code and account number, activates digital banking with biometric SCA (FIDO2/WebAuthn), and receives welcome communications. Full journey completes in under 10 minutes.

steps.description: Customer submits personal details (name, DOB, address, email, phone, nationality), selects 'standard current account', confirms age 18+ and UK residency.

data.applicant: { first_name, last_name, date_of_birth, nationality, email, phone, addresses }

steps.description: SVC-017 calls SVC-001 to create ApplicationRecord (ENT-007) and Customer prospect record (ENT-001). Preliminary eligibility checks run: age >= 18, UK residency, deduplication.
SVC-001 publishes ApplicationStarted domain event to the event bus after creating ApplicationRecord with status = in_progress.
Returns application_id, application_ref, customer_id, status = in_progress, current_phase = PH-002.

data.ApplicationResponse: { application_id, application_ref, customer_id, status, current_phase: PH-002 }

steps.description: Customer receives in-app confirmation: 'Your application has been started. Reference: APP-2026-0042391.'
Triggered by ApplicationStarted event consumption. SVC-017 calls SVC-050 to initiate identity verification. Customer has selected passport as document type.

data.InitiateVerificationRequest: { application_id, customer_id, channel: mobile_app, document_type: passport, customer_name, date_of_birth, residential_address }

steps.description: SVC-050 returns verification_id and vendor_sdk_token (Onfido JWT). SDK token is passed to the mobile app for document capture and liveness check UI.

steps.action: Display document capture + liveness check UI
steps.description: Mobile app renders Onfido SDK UI. Customer captures passport photo and completes biometric liveness check (selfie).

data.ui: Onfido SDK: document capture + selfie liveness check

steps.action: Onfido SDK completes — vendor webhook result
steps.description: Onfido SDK submits document and biometric data directly to Onfido vendor. Onfido returns result to SVC-050 via webhook: document PASS, biometric_match_score = 0.96, address_verification = confirmed.

data.vendor_result: { outcome: pass, document_type: passport, biometric_match_score: 0.96, address_verification_result: confirmed }

steps.note: Biometric template never transmitted to or stored by the bank — only the outcome scalar is persisted per UK GDPR Article 9 data minimisation.

steps.description: SVC-050 persists IdentityVerification (ENT-002) with outcome = pass and publishes IdentityVerificationCompleted event. Payload must not include document_number, biometric template, or biometric_match_score.

data.payload: { verification_id, customer_id, document_type: passport, verification_provider: onfido, outcome: pass, verification_timestamp }

steps.description: SVC-017 receives IdentityVerificationCompleted (outcome: pass) and displays in-app: 'Identity confirmed. We are now completing a few background checks — please wait.'

data.notification: In-app: Identity confirmed — background checks in progress

steps.description: SVC-014 receives IdentityVerificationCompleted event and immediately initiates KYC/CDD assessment. First step: synchronous sanctions screening via SVC-051. Must complete within 3,000ms hard limit (GOV-005-R02).

data.SanctionsScreenRequest: { screening_request_id, entity_type: individual, individual: { first_name, last_name, date_of_birth, nationality: [GB] }, lists_to_check: [OFSI, OFAC, UN, EU], match_threshold_percentage: 85, context: { application_id, customer_id } }

steps.description: SVC-051 returns sanctions screening result: status = clear, all four lists (OFSI, OFAC, UN, EU) returned clear. Processing time 312ms.

data.SanctionsScreenResponse: { status: clear, overall_result: clear, lists_checked: [OFSI, OFAC, UN, EU], processing_time_ms: 312 }

steps.action: Run PEP screening + adverse media screening
steps.description: SVC-014 runs PEP screening via ComplyAdvantage/Refinitiv World-Check and adverse media screening concurrently. Both return CLEAR for this applicant. Risk scoring algorithm assigns risk_score = 22 (simplified tier).
steps.note: Internal SVC-014 computation. PEP and adverse media results persisted in KycAssessment (ENT-003).

steps.description: All checks passed. SVC-014 creates KycAssessment (ENT-003) with status = cleared and publishes KYCClearanceGranted. This is the gating signal for SVC-001 to proceed with account provisioning.

data.payload: { assessment_id, customer_id, risk_category: simplified, assessment_date, next_review_date: +5yr, assessor: automated }

steps.description: SVC-001 receives KYCClearanceGranted event. Decision engine evaluates: identity PASS, KYC CLEAR, risk_category = simplified, age 18+, UK residency confirmed. Decision: APPROVED. POSTs /applications/{id}/decision internally.
SVC-001 publishes ApplicationDecisionMade with outcome = approved. Consumer Duty evidence record created. Decision audit trail retained for 6–7 years.

data.payload: { application_id, customer_id, decision_outcome: approved, decision_basis_ref, decided_at }

steps.description: Customer receives in-app notification and email: 'Great news — your application has been approved. We are setting up your account now.'

SVC-001 creates Account record (ENT-004): assigns sort code (40-47-84) and account number (87654321) from allocated range, sets opening balance = 0.00 GBP, creates FSCS SCV record, triggers CASS registration with Pay.UK, creates CardIssuance record (ENT-005).
steps.note: Account creation and SCV update must be atomic within SVC-001 (GOV-001-R02 PRA Depositor Protection). CASS registration must complete within 2 business days (CASS rules).

steps.description: SVC-001 publishes AccountOpened event after account record is created.

data.payload: { account_id, customer_id, account_type: standard_current, sort_code: 40-47-84, account_number: 87654321, iban, bic, opened_date, fscs_eligible: true }

steps.description: SVC-001 publishes AccountProvisioned after account transitions to status = active (SCV updated, CASS registration initiated).

data.payload: { account_id, customer_id, sort_code, account_number, status: active, cass_registered: false, provisioned_at }

steps.description: CardIssuanceTriggered event dispatched to card processor (SVC-011/Marqeta/Thredd). Physical debit card production and dispatch initiated. Card delivery estimated 3–5 working days. PCI DSS: payload must not contain PAN or CVV2.

data.payload: { card_id, account_id, customer_id, card_type: debit, issued_date, delivery_address (no PAN) }

steps.description: Customer creates online banking username and password. SVC-017 delegates credential storage to SVC-100 (IAM).

SVC-017 calls SVC-100 to: (1) store hashed password, (2) register the customer's device as FIDO2/WebAuthn SCA possession factor, (3) bind the biometric enrolment assertion to the device. Biometric template never leaves the device — only the cryptographic FIDO2 assertion is transmitted (UK GDPR Article 9 data minimisation).

data.credential_creation: { customer_id, hashed_password, fido2_credential_id, device_id, biometric_type: FaceID }

steps.note: SCA enrolment must comply with PSR 2017 Regulation 100 and FCA RTS on SCA. GOV-001-R04.

steps.description: Customer completes first-login SCA using Face ID (FIDO2 biometric assertion) + registered device. SVC-017 verifies SCA with SVC-100.

data.sca: FIDO2 biometric assertion + device possession factor

steps.description: SVC-017 publishes DigitalChannelActivated after SCA enrolment and first login are confirmed. DigitalEnrollment record (ENT-006) created in SVC-017.

data.payload: { customer_id, account_id, channel: mobile_app, sca_enrolled: true, activated_at }

steps.note: Event published by SVC-017, not SVC-001 — SVC-017 owns DigitalEnrollment (ENT-006).

steps.description: SVC-053 triggers welcome communications: (1) welcome email with account details (sort code, account number, card dispatch date, FSCS protection status), (2) in-app welcome message with initial funding prompt and CASS switching option, (3) FSCS information sheet delivered per GOV-001-R02.

data.email: Welcome email: account details, sort code, account number, FSCS info sheet
data.in_app: Initial funding prompt + CASS switching option + vulnerability wellbeing questions

steps.description: WelcomePackDispatched event published after all welcome communications are sent. Journey complete — customer is an active account holder.

notes: End-to-end happy path target: 5–10 minutes (automated path). Card delivery: 3–5 working days.
Sanctions screening (step 12) has a hard 3,000ms SLA per GOV-005-R02. Any breach is an OFSI compliance event.
Biometric templates are never stored by the bank at any step. Only outcome scalars are persisted (UK GDPR Article 9).
All PII remains in UK data residency throughout. No traversal through non-UK CDN nodes or cloud regions.
ApplicationRecord decision_basis_ref is the Consumer Duty evidence record — retained 6–7 years.
FSCS SCV must be maintained such that eligible deposits are extractable within 24 hours of a payout trigger (PRA Depositor Protection).
CASS registration with Pay.UK must complete within 2 business days of account opening (CASS rules).
